# Northwind Haulage Corp — Strategic Overview

## Executive Summary

Northwind Haulage Corp is a mid-market logistics optimization vendor that sells
route-planning and fleet-analytics software to regional carriers. (Reported) The
company occupies a defensible but narrowing niche: optimizing last-mile delivery
for carriers still running legacy dispatch systems. (Estimated)

Revenue is concentrated among a small set of carrier networks, which is both the
core strength and the principal risk. (Hypothesis)

What to validate: confirm the share of revenue tied to the top three carrier
accounts using procurement disclosures or management interviews. [cite: 1]

## Products and Services

The core product is a routing engine paired with a fleet-analytics dashboard.
Pricing has shifted from perpetual licenses toward consumption-based billing,
visible in public procurement portal responses. (Reported) [cite: 2]

What to validate: confirm whether consumption billing has fully replaced
perpetual licenses for new logos. [cite: 2]

## Competitive Landscape

Competition is moderate; differentiation comes from implementation speed and
domain-specific routing heuristics rather than raw model quality. (Estimated)

| Dimension | Northwind | Typical competitor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Onboarding time | Weeks | Months |
| Pricing model | Consumption | Perpetual |

What to validate: benchmark onboarding time against two named competitors in a
reference call. [cite: 3]

## Strategic Positioning

Near-term opportunity is vertical expansion into adjacent freight segments where
the existing routing heuristics transfer with modest retraining. (Hypothesis)

What to validate: confirm whether routing heuristics generalize to the targeted
adjacent segment without a full re-modeling effort. [cite: 1]
